text:
Nora: Quick UX huddle on the routing rules editor. Two consistent issues: the list reorder feels like items teleport on long stacks, and the Preview simulation keeps firing while you're mid-drag causing noisy toasts. Short recording attached. Diego: Repro'd on Chrome. Drag item at index 12 toward index 3, it will sometimes snap past intended slot after a small pause. My guess is snap-width + virtualization chunk boundaries. Priya: Proposal: (1) Lower snap slab width and add a subtle 120ms transform+fade to soften movement. (2) Pause the Preview while a reorder gesture is active and show a small inline badge 'Preview paused while editing'. Jia: Backend detail: sim occasionally returns 202 then 200 while warming caches. Frontend treats any non-200 as error which is why you see the red flash. I'll change the client to treat 202 as 'processing' and show an inline spinner beside the Preview header; will also add a 150ms debounce before sending reorder requests. PR tomorrow. a11y-bot: Automated check: drag-handle contrast 2.4:1 (fail) and interactive target size 18px (fail). Recommendations: increase hit target to >=44px, ensure focus-visible outline meets contrast, add role='button' + aria-label on handle, and expose an aria-live region announcing new position after keyboard moves. Nora: Keyboard flow: show Move Up / Move Down chevrons when a row is focused (visible on hover+focus) and bind Alt+Shift+Up / Alt+Shift+Down to move. After a move announce: 'Moved rule "RateLimit-Login" to position 4 of 14'. Current SR just says 'Saved' which is useless. Priya: Copy tweak: replace terse 'Invalid rule precedence' with 'Order not applied check for locked rules or circular dependencies.' Use short toast 'Order not saved resolve dependencies.' Diego: Small microinteraction ask: reduce snap sensitivity near list edges to avoid crossing virtualization seams. Also animate with fade so users keep spatial context. Jia: I'll implement 202 handling + spinner + debounce. For SR I'll add a polite live region snippet to the component library:
Moved rule "RateLimit-Login" to position 4 of 14
and emit the exact text after keyboard moves. Nora: Great. Action items: @Jia PR for API/ack + spinner and debounce; @Priya update error copy; @Diego prototype the fade + reduced snap; I'll prioritize the hit-target and focus-visible fixes flagged by a11y-bot. Sync Thurs 10:30am PT if needed. Thanks! :sparkles:
